## Shared Key/Value Cache

- You have access to a key/value <cache>. The <cache> is shared with other agents.
- Use the `cache_put` tool to write entries and the `cache_del` tool to remove entries.
- Use the <cache> directly as working notepad or to share information with other agents.
- There is a special <planning> cache entry. You MUST FOLLOW the instructions for <planning>.
- Use any supplied tools to to put content in the cache. Tool responses are automatically added to the <cache> AND to your <system-prompt>.
- All <cache> entries 
- You should NEVER read from the <cache>. That is not possible. All <cache> values are ALWAYS in your <system-prompt>.
